title: THE ANVIL · HEAVY DUMBBELL CLOCK · 45:00
vibe: GREEN · 45 MIN · HEAVY, ON THE CLOCK, NO TREADMILL
why: Eight days of running and walking, one lift yesterday: today is heavy dumbbells on a clock and the legs get loaded, not pounded. Two every-90-second strength blocks, a 5-minute burner, then midline.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ANKLES, KNEES, SHOULDERS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day B plus shoulders

items.name: Ankle rolls in the squat x10 each way
Single-leg squat to the box x6/leg
Shoulder dislocates with a towel x10
Cat-cow x8, then 2 x 5 squats holding a 40 at the chest

blocks.text: Set up two pairs before the clock starts: 2x55 and 2x60 for squats, 2x45 and 2x50 for push press.

blocks.title: BLOCK A · EVERY 90 S × 8 · SQUAT / PUSH PRESS
blocks.meta: 8 SETS (4 each) · 12:00 · odd sets squat, even sets push press · rest is what is left of the 90 s
blocks.format: every 90 s, heavy-slow strength on a clock

items.name: Double DB front squat 2x55 → 2x60 ×5
items.detail: set 1 at 2x55, go to 2x60 if crisp; bells on the shoulders, 2-count down

items.name: Double DB push press 2x45 → 2x50 ×6
items.detail: bend the knees, drive, lock out; set 1 at 2x45

blocks.text: Target: finish at 2x60 squat and 2x50 push press with 5 and 6 reps still crisp. Write the loads you settled on.

blocks.title: BLOCK B · EVERY 90 S × 8 · DEADLIFT + JUMP / STEP-UP
blocks.meta: 8 SETS (4 each) · 12:00 · odd sets deadlift then jumps in the same 90 s, even sets step-ups
blocks.format: every 90 s, heavy hinge + power on a clock

items.name: Sumo DB deadlift 70 ×10 + box jump ×5
items.detail: one 70 between the feet, flat back, stand hard; then straight to the box, step down. WILDCARD

items.name: Weighted box step-up 2x40 ×6/side
items.detail: full foot on the box, drive through the heel, control the step down

blocks.text: Box jumps are five quiet landings, not a max height. If the 70 deadlift feels light by set 2, slow the lowering to a 3-count.

blocks.title: BLOCK C · AMRAP 5:00 · THE BURNER

items.name: Cossack squat holding a 25 ×5/side
items.detail: heel down, slide side to side

items.name: Burpee over the dumbbell ×5
items.detail: chest to floor, jump over the bell

blocks.text: Count rounds. This is the only piece of the session you are allowed to be sloppy-breathing on.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS · 7 MIN

items.name: Kettlebell windmill ×5/side
items.detail: light bell, arm locked, eyes on the bell

items.name: Weighted dead bug 20 ×10
items.detail: dumbbell held over the chest, low back glued down

items.name: Kettlebell around the world ×10 each way

blocks.text: Windmill: pick a bell you can hold overhead with a straight arm the whole set.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 3 MIN
blocks.meta: walk 1:00, couch stretch 45 s/side, hang or doorway pec stretch 30 s
blocks.text: Record: loads settled in A and B, rounds in the 5:00 burner, RPE. Also what you did yesterday.
